nl_spec: Design a current mirror in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: input current 20 uA, target output current 20 uA (ratio 1) at 0.9 V. Requirements: output-current error relative to the target of at most 5 %; output resistance at the nominal output voltage of at least 330 kohm; output compliance voltage (minimum output voltage keeping >=95% of the current) of at most 0.49 V.

Design a current mirror in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: input current 20 uA, target output current 80 uA (ratio 4) at 0.9 V. Requirements: output-current error relative to the target of at most 3 %; output compliance voltage (minimum output voltage keeping >=95% of the current) of at most 0.31 V; output resistance at the nominal output voltage of at least 11 Mohm.
